Subject: FinServe discovery — recap & next steps

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for taking the time today — appreciated the context on your fraud-detection pipeline and peak inference patterns. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

- What we heard: FinServe wants a low-latency reranking endpoint for transaction scoring (p95 < 120ms) and predictable cost for 2M monthly requests.
- Proposed approach: Dedicated capacity with autoscale for peak hours + prefix caching for common customer prompts.
- Success metrics: p95 latency, cost per 1k requests, and model accuracy on your test prompts.

Next steps:
1) I’ll send a mutual action plan and a SOW draft for procurement. (attached)
2) Rishi will follow up on the technical checklist and model compatibility items.
3) You mentioned procurement would need an SOW + W-9 to start vendor setup — let me know the right contact.

Attached: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf (first draft)

If this looks right I can loop in procurement and send the official SOW.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
